Assuming “afternoon” means roughly 12:00–5:00:

- Thursday — completely free (any 2-hour slot).
- Friday — free from 12:00 onward (so e.g., 12:00–14:00).

Notes/alternatives:
- If you use 1:00–5:00 as “afternoon,” Thursday and Friday still work; Wednesday also has 1:00–3:00 free (but is booked 3:00–4:00).  
- Monday is booked 14:00–16:00 (so only 12:00–14:00 would be a 2-hour option if you count 12:00 as afternoon).  
- Tuesday is fully blocked 13:00–17:00.
